name: [Beastyqt] OOTD 1 TC Aggression
author: Gloom

description:
* This Build Order focuses on early pressure using powerful units from the Order of the Dragon.
* It highlights resource management to sustain the expensive army units.
* The strategy allows you to create two unit types to counter your opponent's forces and change unit types as needed.
This Build Order was created by Beastyqt.
name: Beastyqt’s OOTD Aggresive Strategy - Simplified
author: othmen

notes: Send a @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.png@ to build a @building_economy/mill.png@ and then to @resource/berrybush.png@

Send @unit_worker/villager.webp@@landmark_hre/meinwerk-palace.png@ to build @building_military/stable.png@ and then to @resource/sheep.png@ (Immediately start producing @unit_dragon/gilded-horseman-2.png@)
With your first @unit_dragon/gilded-horseman-2.webp@, go harass enemy @unit_worker/villager.png@

Build @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and start producing @unit_dragon/gilded-archer-2.png@. If your enemy goes cavalry, build a @building_military/barracks.png@ instead and produce @unit_dragon/gilded-spearman-1.png@
@resource/rally.webp@ 2 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@. Then @resource/rally.png@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ until you have 14

Research @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@/@technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.png@/@technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@/@technology_military/bloomery.png@ depending on your enemy’s army composition
watch over the population limit  @civilization_flag/dra.webp@ military units take 2 population spaces. Build @building_economy/house.png@ when you need it

When you run out of food, go for @resource/boar.webp@ or @resource/deer.png@ if it is safe. then research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.png@. Slowly build @building_economy/farm.png@ before running out of food sources. Research @technology_economy/horticulture.png@ in that case
@resource/rally.webp@@unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ until 15. Then rally to @resource/resource_food.png@ again

From now on, the match depends on your enemy’s response and army composition. Research @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@/@technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.png@/@technology_military/steeled-arrow.png@/@technology_military/bloomery.png@, build more @building_military/barracks.png@/@building_military/archery-range.png@/@building_military/stable.png@, research @technology_military/siege-engineering.png@ to build @unit_siege/battering-ram.png@, save resources to age up to @age/age_3.png@ and send more @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_gold.png@ to produce @unit_dragon/gilded-knight-3.png@/@unit_dragon/gilded-crossbowman-3.png@, or decide what you believe is best for the match.

description:
First time making a guide and I couldn't find any for 2 TC and I like econ. Hope this gets refined by others especially into the wood transition. There is a bit of a delay between when you get 350 stone and the 400 wood. About 10-20 sec depending, but I guess thats a good time to move the stone vills to where you need the 2nd TC made. You can generally start making archers from 6:45 when the archery range gets built but you are still quite vulnerable to pre 2nd TC built rush. Idea is, the second you age up to 2, you should be able to put down your second TC. 

If you are good with sheep, 4 vills on food, and rest and rally to wood should be fine. If you are severely lacking sheep, you should get the 5th vill to make mill and go to berries. Will slow you down by 50 wood though.
name: Fast 2 TC Econ Power House
author: andymiky

notes: @unit_worker/villager-abbasid.webp@ x2 rally to @resource/resource_gold.png@, build @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ , w/ second build @building_economy/house.png@

Spearman @unit_dragon/gilded-spearman-1.webp@ x4  and  Archer @unit_dragon/gilded-archer-2.png@ x8 , 1st TC to @resource/resource_gold.png@, 2nd TC to @resource/resource_food.png@ , get @technology_economy/specialized-pick.png@
Keep building @building_economy/farm.webp@ and rallying to 1st TC @resource/resource_gold.png@ and 2nd TC @resource/resource_food.png@

description: WAM uses this build to get his 2nd TC finished at 5:30 and then FC, but you can use this for aggression
name: WAM's OOTD 2TC 5:30 Benchmark
author: Acklex

notes: First vil builds house then mining camp on gold
Age up with 2 gold vills until about halfway done then send 1 of the builders to wood
Once you've placed the blueprint down of the landmark, send 4 food vills to stone, and 1 to wood
Around ~7 vils on wood, you should have enough stone for the 2nd TC, so pull the stone vills off and put them on wood
Next vil produced goes to wood, and landmark building vil goes to food
Next vil produced goes to food, and pull 10 vills off wood to build 2nd TC on food
TC should be done. From here on out, if you want to go FC, put on food until 17-18, and gold until 6-7

2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to @resource/resource_food.png@ && 2 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to @resource/resource_wood.png@ && 1 @unit_worker/villager.png@ to build @building_military/barracks.png@ (goes back to food)

When 60/150 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ in @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.png@ OR 50 @resource/resource_wood.png@ in bank build a @building_economy/mining-camp.png@ with your 2 @resource/resource_wood.png@ @unit_worker/villager.png@
Go to 5 on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for normal @building_military/barracks.png@+@building_military/stable.png@ Production. Go to 7-8 ish for @unit_dragon/gilded-archer-2.png@ production.

f opponent goes @building_military/barracks.png@/@building_military/archery-range.png@ you can run @unit_dragon/gilded-man-at-arms-2.png@+@unit_dragon/gilded-archer-2.png@. If you need mobility, then run tri-comp / 1-1-1 comp
From here on, macro for offense, dont go 2nd TC or FC unless 100% necessary. Try to get an archer ball going with maa and horsemen. Add spearmen if they go for Horsemen after your archer followup.
This is just an opener. You decide where you want to take the feudal game, but it is usually best to go 1tc all in :)
Check video for additional tips on dealing with feudal aggro or FC from opponent.
